root.label: Study on rising commercial property insurance costs

events.label: Study on rising commercial property insurance costs

slots.name: insurance premium growth
slots.sentence: Using property-level data from Agency Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities deals covering more than 100,000 multifamily properties across the U.S, the authors find that between 2019 and 2024, average commercial property insurance premiums have grown more than 15% a year

slots.name: rent pass-through
slots.sentence: On average, roughly half of insurance-cost increases were reflected in rents.

slots.name: income decline
slots.sentence: The study estimates that in the areas experiencing the largest insurance increases, net operating income may have fallen by more than 25% over the past decade.
